headline: EQUINOX-ORLA $18.5B MERGER GETS SHAREHOLDER GREEN LIGHT — 1.1M Oz 2026 Target, Court July 28, Closes ~July 31; Canada's Biggest Gold Deal of the Year (TSX/NYSE: EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX/NYSE: EQX) and Orla Mining shareholders both overwhelmingly approved the all-share business combination on July 22, 2026 — with 99.91% of Orla votes and 99.83% of Equinox votes in favour — creating a combined company targeting 1.1 million ounces of 2026 gold production and a longer-term path to 1.9 million ounces annually. Former Orla shareholders receive one Equinox share per Orla share held and will own approximately 33% of the combined entity at an implied combined market cap of C$18.5 billion; a BC Supreme Court approval hearing is expected on or about July 28 with deal close targeting July 31 — establishing one of Canada's premier intermediate gold producers with a diversified Latin American and North American asset base.

headline: NTH CYCLE'S $585M SPAC RESHORES US CRITICAL MINERAL REFINING — Cobalt-Nickel-REE From Battery Scrap Goes Public; $1.1B Trafigura Off-Take Locked (NYSE: NTH)
snippet: Nth Cycle Inc. announced July 23 a definitive business combination with Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI at an implied enterprise value of $585 million, creating the first US-based commercial refinery producing high-purity nickel-cobalt mixed hydroxide product from recycled battery feedstock — directly addressing the American dependence on Chinese critical mineral processing. The company's OYSTER electroextraction technology handles nickel, cobalt, copper and rare earth value chains at lower capex and emissions than conventional hydromet; Trafigura holds a 10-year off-take term sheet worth approximately $1.1 billion and the combined company will trade on the NYSE as 'NTH' following deal close.

headline: DEFIANCE DRILLS 1,470 g/t SILVER BONANZA AT SAN ACACIO — Zacatecas 21-Hole Diamond Program Validates Grade Model; Maiden MRE Targeting Q4 2026 (TSXV: DEF)
snippet: Defiance Silver Corp. (TSXV: DEF) reported July 23 assay results from holes DDSA-26-82 through DDSA-26-88 in its 10,000-metre diamond drill program at the Zacatecas Project in Mexico, with peak results returning 1,470 g/t silver — confirming the lateral and vertical extension of known structures and validating the geological model underpinning the upcoming Mineral Resource Estimate. With 6,132 metres across 21 holes completed and samples from holes 89–92 already at the lab, the program is tracking toward a maiden MRE in Q4 2026 that could establish Defiance as one of the few junior silver plays with a standalone high-grade resource in Mexico's proven Zacatecas silver belt.

headline: LARAMIDE'S WESTMORELAND URANIUM SCORES $741M NPV AT $90/LB U3O8 — 33% IRR, 47.9 Mlb Life-of-Mine at $32.40/Lb Cash Cost; First PEA Update Since 2016 (TSX/ASX: LAM)
snippet: Laramide Resources (TSX/ASX: LAM) released July 22 an updated PEA for the wholly-owned Westmoreland Uranium Project in Queensland, Australia, returning a post-tax NPV(8%) of US$741.1 million and a post-tax IRR of 33% at a US$90/lb uranium price — with an 11-year open-pit operation processing 2.9 million tonnes annually, average yearly production of 4.9 million lb U3O8, life-of-mine output of 47.9 million pounds, and average cash costs of US$32.40/lb at 95% uranium recovery. The study replaces Laramide's 2016 assessment and positions Westmoreland for the next development phase at a uranium price that sits within 6% of current spot — with Shaw & Partners projecting uranium at US$175/lb in 2027.

headline: LITHIUM SINKS TO 5-MONTH LOW AS CATL JIANXIAWO, BALD HILL AND FINNISS ALL RESTART TOGETHER — Wave of Supply Stokes 2027 Glut Fears; Futures Slip to ¥143,000/T
snippet: Lithium futures in China fell to a five-month low of ¥143,000 CNY/tonne as three significant suspended operations cleared the path back to production simultaneously: CATL's Jianxiawo mine — among the world's largest — received security permits to restore activity following its prolonged suspension, while Mineral Resources restarted Bald Hill after 18 months idle and Core Lithium restarted Finniss. The coordinated supply response is outpacing near-term EV and energy storage demand signals and has markets pricing in a meaningful 2027 oversupply scenario — a sharp contrast with the spodumene price above $2,000/t CIF China that incentivised these restarts and now risks being undermined by the supply it created.

headline: ICSG FLIPS 2026 COPPER TO 150,000-TONNE DEFICIT — Chile-Peru Disruptions, VAT Crackdown Push China Import Premium to $100/T; Spot Holds $6.44/Lb
snippet: The International Copper Study Group reversed its 2026 copper market forecast from a 209,000-tonne surplus to a 150,000-tonne deficit — a 359,000-tonne swing — as mine delays and accidents in Chile and Peru constrained Latin American output. China's import premium for refined copper climbed to $100/tonne, its highest since May last year, as Beijing's crackdown on VAT fraud in the scrap market redirected demand to imported refined metal and tightened domestic availability; spot copper held near US$6.44/lb on July 22 with physical tightness expected to build through Q3 as limited concentrate availability constrains global smelter output despite 2.3% forecast mine production growth for 2026.

headline: TOCVAN FINDS AT-SURFACE 581 g/t Ag, 2.2 g/t Au ZONE 900M FROM PILOT FACILITY — Gran Pilar District Grows; Q4 2026 First Production On Track (TSXV: TOC)
snippet: Tocvan Ventures Corp. (TSXV: TOC) announced July 23 the discovery of a new high-grade silver-gold zone at surface — 900 metres east of the planned pilot facility at Gran Pilar in Sonora, Mexico — with hole JES-26-152 returning 1.5 metres at 2.2 g/t Au and 581 g/t Ag, intersected via the company's fully funded 20,000-metre drill program. The discovery extends the project's resource potential in close proximity to existing road access and planned processing infrastructure, strengthening production planning optionality ahead of the fully permitted 50,000-tonne pilot mine targeting first gold-silver doré in Q4 2026.

headline: AVINO Q2 2026: 534,945 AgEq OZ AS LA PRECIOSA CONTRIBUTION SURGES 59% — 267,305 Silver Oz, 2,178 Gold Oz; Full Financials Aug 12 (TSX/NYSE: ASM)
snippet: Avino Silver & Gold Mines (TSX/NYSE: ASM) reported Q2 2026 production of 267,305 oz silver, 2,178 oz gold, and 729,929 lb copper totalling 534,945 silver-equivalent ounces, with La Preciosa development production surging 59% quarter-over-quarter to 100,658 AgEq oz as the newer operation ramps up alongside the flagship Avino mine. Mill throughput came in on plan at 184,293 tonnes processed; overall production was down 17% year-over-year on lower copper output and recoveries, though La Preciosa's trajectory provides a credible path to H2 growth with full financial results due August 12, 2026.

headline: CHINA RARE EARTH INDEX HOLDS AT 271 AS HEAVY RARE EARTH CRUNCH INTENSIFIES — Terbium Near $1,000/KG, Dysprosium Elevated; Western Buyers Locked Out of Commercial Supply
snippet: China's Rare Earth Price Index settled at 271.4 on July 22 with terbium oxide near $999–1,009/kg and dysprosium oxide at $204–210/kg — both remaining elevated due to state quotas and export controls that have nothing to do with transparent market pricing. Western manufacturers continue to report severe difficulty sourcing heavy rare earth oxides and metals in commercial volumes with reliable delivery; only roughly 10% of global rare earth separation capacity sits outside China, leaving ex-China pricing dependent on confidential bilateral contracts unavailable to most buyers. China's MOFCOM tightened the grip further with a new export-control whistleblower mechanism effective July 1 — adding structural urgency to efforts to build independent Western supply chains for EV magnets and wind turbines.
